info.description: One credit-gated eligibility/ranking run against the program catalog for a student. Persists the exact input and result snapshot for audit and replay.

inputSnapshot.description: The profile revision used: level, cgpaPercentage, budgetAnnualEUR, specializationKeywords, targetIntake.

catalogVersion.description: Lightweight version marker (MAX(updatedAt) across the catalog tables at run time), not a full immutable snapshot.

results.description: Array of { programId, programType, universityId, verdict, reasons[], scoreBreakdown: { subjectCareer, affordability, timingReadiness, locationFormat, total }, rank }.
